name: Constellation Brands, Inc.
base_source: TTM through Q2 FY2027 from EDGAR 10-Q YTD (OCF $2,658.3M = FY26 $2,669.0M - H1 FY26 $1,489.3M + H1 FY27 $1,478.6M; minus capex TTM $819.0M and SBC TTM $70.5M = $1,768.8M / 171.503M H1 FY27 diluted shares from the 10-Q EPS note — EDGAR companyfacts carries no weighted-share series for STZ); 3-yr median from filing-text share counts is $9.83/share
moat_justification: Moderate-strong brands, concentrated and category-capped: Modelo Especial (#1 U.S. beer by dollars) and Corona with exclusive perpetual U.S. rights, owned Mexican breweries, ~39% beer margins and a decade of pricing/share gains — against single-category, single-supply-country (Mexico tariffs/peso) and single-demand-country concentration, disproportionate exposure to the Hispanic consumer pullback driving negative depletions, and a U.S. beer category in secular volume decline.
fragility_flags: STALE_FY: latest fiscal year ended 7 months ago — check TTM/quarterly OE and consider --base-oe-ps override
NI_OCF_DIVERGENCE: net income and operating cash flow differ by >40% in 2025 — find the one-off (tax deposits, impairments, WC swings) before trusting the OE base
one_liner: Premier import-beer franchise, moat 6/10 — but depletions are negative (Modelo ~-2%, Corona ~-5%), FY27 organic sales and comparable EPS are guided flat, and net debt is 5.8x TTM OE, so at $126.40 (12.3x TTM OE of $10.31/share) the weighted IRR is only 10.1% (IV@15% $77.67); it clears the 15% hurdle only below ~$78, nearer ~$62 with a margin of safety.
